steps.source: let count=0;class P<T:type>{static{count++;}}function make(){class C{}return type C;}const A=make(),B=make();const p=P.<A>,q=P.<B>,again=P.<A>;String(count)+"/"+String(p===again)+"/"+String(p===q);
class P<T:type>{}function make(){class C{}return type C;}const A=make(),B=make();const p=P.<P.<A>>,q=P.<P.<B>>,again=P.<P.<A>>;String(p===again)+"/"+String(p===q);

cases.name: class type stays declared after ordinary reassignment

steps.source: function make(){class C{}const old=type C;C=class D{};return String((type C)===old);}make();
class A{}class B{}String(Reflect.isAssignable(type A,type B));
function make(){class A{}class B extends A{}return {a:type A,b:type B};}const x=make(),y=make();String(Reflect.isAssignable(x.b,x.a))+"/"+String(Reflect.isAssignable(x.b,y.a));
let count=0;class P<T:type>{static{count++;}}function make(){type Before=C;const first=P.<Before>;class C{}const second=P.<C>;return String(first===second);}make()+"/"+String(count);
